obligations.title: Capability is preserved where legitimate
obligations.text_verbatim:
Deprecation should migrate the mechanism without casually removing the legitimate business capability.

Example:

```text
Old need:
Add a customer-specific field.

Old mechanism:
Ad-hoc field or runtime modification.

New mechanism:
Generated field-extension declaration with equivalent field,
permissions, migration, and compatibility visibility.
```

Where equivalent capability cannot yet be preserved, the migration is not complete.
obligations.gist: Deprecation migrate mechanism without casually removing legitimate business capability.

approved_messaging.title: E0 launch-era wording
approved_messaging.text_verbatim:
**Headline**

> **Built for upgrade-safe customization**

**Subhead**

> AFENDA gives every extension a declared contract, so customization can be evaluated rather than rediscovered at upgrade time.

**Proof CTA**

> View the Upgrade Compatibility Report

approved_messaging.text_verbatim:
> AFENDA turns ERP upgrade compatibility from a consulting discovery exercise into a versioned, deployment-specific, machine-checkable product capability.

revisit_triggers: buyer interviews do not rank customisation-driven upgrade risk among the highest-value problems;
customers value module breadth materially more than upgrade visibility in the chosen segment;
the compatibility report does not change purchase, upgrade, or partner decisions;
false-compatible results persist despite corrective controls;
the closed extension model prevents legitimate customer value that cannot be represented safely;
partners do not achieve better reuse or delivery economics;
a competitor offers materially equivalent contract-native, deployment-specific compatibility evidence;
market or jurisdiction changes make another pain more urgent.

adopted_items: contract-native report rather than heuristic-only scanning;
partner proposition as a measured hypothesis;
